PLUGIN_HOSTD_PIN_VERDICTS.doc: What the qualification of the pinned bytes said: the value of a pin's verdict key. A pin with no verdict was learned on first use and carries no judgment. A word outside these is not a pin's.

inProcess.doc: qualified to run in a worker that other plugins share

isolated.doc: qualified to run, in a worker of its own

refused.doc: failed qualification: the pin records the bytes, a host should not load them

PLUGIN_HOSTD_PIN_POOLS.doc: Whether the plugin's qualification measured the CLAP thread pool real-time safe and faster at the quantum: the value of a pin's pool key. A plugin with no word runs serial. A word outside these is not a pin's.

cores.doc: its worker starts with the thread pool on, one helper per core of its cpu set but one, and no other plugin shares the worker

off.doc: measured, and not faster or not safe with the pool: the worker keeps no option
